mailgate.description: Self-hosted receive-only OTP and magic-link email inbox running on Cloudflare Email Routing, Workers, and D1. Lets Claude Code wait for incoming verification codes and sign-in links during Playwright or browser E2E authentication tests via mailgate_wait_for_otp, mailgate_wait_for_email, mailgate_list_messages, and optional admin tools. Runs locally over stdio via npx and requires a deployed MailGate Worker URL in MAILGATE_URL.
